findings.evidence: lib/policy_check_invocation.sh:48-49: `if [ -z "$path" ] || [ -z "$expected" ]; then return 0; fi` — confirmed at HEAD (commit 1cbd1e5) via direct file read. lib:67-68: `"${SCP_POLICY_CHECK_OPA_BIN:-}"` and `"${SCP_POLICY_CHECK_OPA_SHA256:-}"` — unchanged. lib:72-73: `"${SCP_POLICY_CHECK_CONFTEST_BIN:-}"` and `"${SCP_POLICY_CHECK_CONFTEST_SHA256:-}"` — unchanged. dispatcher-result.json for fix-round-2: `"timed_out": true`, `"git_sha_before": "8d1eaf1...", "git_sha_after": "8d1eaf1..."` — proves the dispatcher committed nothing. findings.impact: An estate adopter that sources .scp-runtime/lib/policy_check_invocation.sh and calls scp_policy_check_run without pre-exporting the four env vars — precisely the direct-sourcing scenario that F-002 (SCP runtime checkout) enabled for external callers — receives a silent pass on the pre-execution verification gate and runs the system- or PATH-resolved conftest binary without any integrity check. A pre-staged malicious binary at a high-priority PATH location (e.g. /usr/local/bin/conftest) would be executed with the full changed-file list and policy-bundle inputs, no race required. This directly undermines the supply-chain trust model the library exists to enforce.
findings.mitigation: Apply R2-SAF-MAJ-01's stated remediation: (1) change lib/policy_check_invocation.sh:48-49 from `return 0` to `scp_policy_check_emit_error "SCP-E001" "" "${label} binary path or expected SHA256 is not configured; export SCP_POLICY_CHECK_${label}_BIN and SCP_POLICY_CHECK_${label}_SHA256 before sourcing this library"; return 1`. (2) In scp_policy_check_verify_runtime_binaries, change the four `:-` operators at lines 67-68 and 72-73 to `:?` — or add explicit pre-call guards — so unset vars fail with a diagnostic before reaching the function. (3) Add a test that sources the lib, calls scp_policy_check_run with unset BIN/SHA256 vars, and asserts non-zero exit with SCP-E001 in stderr. If the `return 0` behavior on empty inputs is intentionally kept for no-op callers, document a skip-verification sentinel variable (e.g. SCP_POLICY_CHECK_SKIP_RUNTIME_VERIFY=1) and require explicit opt-in rather than silent pass-through.
